briefing: The survivors of the frontier companies have fallen back to Kesh Ridge, the last high ground before the town of Kesh. Eleven thousand civilians are still waiting for trucks in the streets below.
Lieutenant Anya Rusk's platoon of the 9th Infantry holds a double line of trenches across the ridge. Her orders are simple: keep the Directorate off the ridge until the last convoy has left.
Nobody expects the line to hold. It only has to hold long enough.
story_objective: Buy time for the evacuation of Kesh.
gameplay_objective: Hold the forward trench, destroy the enemy machine-gun nest, fall back to the second line, hold it until the convoy is ready and reach the last truck.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day Two. Kesh Ridge. What was left of the frontier companies dug in above the town.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eleven thousand people were still in Kesh. The trucks needed six hours.

lines.speaker: rusk
lines.text: Ridgeback survivors? Good. Today every rifle counts.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kesh Ridge held for five hours and forty minutes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Long enough. The last convoy left Kesh at 21:50.

objective.text: Report to Lt. Rusk at the command bunker

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Lieutenant's at the command bunker. Let's get our orders.

on_complete.speaker: rusk
on_complete.text: They'll come across no-man's land any minute. Get into the forward trench, centre section.

objective.text: Take position in the forward trench

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: Down the communication trench, Halden. Keep your head low.

on_complete.speaker: voss
on_complete.text: Movement at their trench line. Lots of it.

on_start.speaker: rusk
on_start.text: Here they come! Hold your fire until they reach the wire! Steady, damn it!

on_start.speaker: hammer
on_start.text: Hammer, fire mission. Rounds on the way - heads down!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Keep firing! Don't let those bastards reach the trench!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: RPG! Crater line, left! Shit, get down!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: They just keep coming! How many of these fuckers are there?!

on_start.speaker: rusk
on_start.text: Machine guns, sweep the wire! Cut them down!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Medic! Rifleman down on the right! Damn it!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Another wave! Behind the smoke! Fuck, it's a whole battalion!

on_complete.speaker: bastion
on_complete.text: Kesh Ridge, Bastion: enemy armour moving on your sector. Hold them.

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: TANKS! Two of them, coming straight down the middle!

on_start.speaker: rusk
on_start.text: Halden! Grab the launcher - kill those fucking tanks!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Switch to the launcher, Tomas - press three! Aim for the hull!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: That tank's turning towards us! Oh fuck, oh fuck!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Rocket team's down! It's on you, Halden!

on_complete.speaker: marek
on_complete.text: Hell yes! Both tanks are burning!

on_complete.speaker: rusk
on_complete.text: Machine gun, centre-right, in the crater line! Shit, it's cutting us to pieces!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Halden, Kell - with me. Voss, cover us from the trench.

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Sappers! They're running for the wire with charges!

on_start.speaker: rusk
on_start.text: Shoot the sappers! Shoot them NOW!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: There's too many! I can't stop them all!
THE LINE IS BROKEN

on_complete.speaker: rusk
on_complete.text: The line's gone! Everyone back to the second line - NOW! MOVE!

objective.text: Fall back to the second line

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Go, go! Don't stop for anything!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: They're right behind us! Fuck, run!

objective.text: Hold the second line until the convoy is ready

on_start.speaker: convoy
on_start.text: Convoy Two-Six to Kesh Ridge: loading the last families now. Give us a few more minutes.

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: Shells are falling on the trucks! There are kids down there!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Eyes front, Kell! If we break, they all die!

on_start.speaker: rusk
on_start.text: They're in the communication trenches! Shit! Watch the junctions!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Third tank! It's on the old line, shelling us!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: Oh god... they hit the crowd. They hit the fucking crowd!

on_complete.speaker: convoy
on_complete.text: Convoy Two-Six: we're full. Last truck is waiting for you - move!

on_complete.speaker: rusk
on_complete.text: That's our signal! Go, Halden! Go, damn it! We'll cover you!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Truck four! Get in, get in!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: We made it... we actually made it.

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: RPG! Behind us! Truck five!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: No! NO! There are people in there!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Keep driving! Don't stop the truck!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: They're shooting them! They're shooting them in the back!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Don't look, Tomas. Don't look.

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: We left them... we just left them there.
